ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across the central and basal regions, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized on the distal lobes; approximate 65:35 black-to-white pixel distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central black mass spanning from the peduncle to the notch. Distal white fields begin approximately 50% along the lobe length. Left lobe white field contains dense, irregular black spotting and a distinct dark linear stroke. Right lobe white field shows finer, more isolated dark pixel clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 140 degrees and shallow bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged indentation visible on the left lobe trailing edge approximately one-third of the distance from the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve transitioning from central convexity to lateral concavity near the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Brown-toned, high-contrast pixel clusters localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, dark vertical linear marking is visible on the white pigmentation field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep asymmetric indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe; visible calcified or necrotic tissue (tan/brown) at the extreme distal tips.
